title: How do I have a character stand in a certain position in a cutscene.

posts.author: RyanJimenez
posts.body: Hello, I just started learning RPG Maker XP and I was wondering how to get the character in a certain position in a cutscene, because everytime I press play to test it, the character sprite is forward all the time. Just needed advice, and I probably will need more help on this server in the future. Have a great day!

posts.author: Andar
posts.body:
we need a screenshot of the cutscene event itself and how that character is supposed to move at all before we can help.
because normally you just place the event pretending to be the character where it is supposed to be, the computer does nothing without you telling it to.

posts.author: Andar
posts.body:
many very basic mistakes - I strongly suggest you work through tutorials on events to learn the very basics before continuing.
First: conditions need to be true before the event commands on their page are executed.
so if there is a condition switch on an event page, that event page will only be processed after another event has turned on that switch. And the only event without a condition never controls those switches.
Second, autorun automatically loops. unless you stop that by either switching to a different page or erasing the event, the autoruns will restart after coming to an end. That is what is usually done with the self-switch A, but you copied that without understanding that it needs a second page with that condition to take effect.
Third, you seem to misunderstand the purpose of several commands. For example changing the picture tone does nothing if you don't have a picture to change the tone of.
